ex.q: Where do we stand out against rivals?
ex.a: From the Elevation SanTan website: a fourth floor sky lounge, resort style pool and spa with cabanas, a two level fitness center, a lounge with built in workstations, a resident conference center, two gated dog parks, a pet wash, garages on select homes and gated access, a walk from SanTan Village.

ex.q: Who showed the tour? Pending service requests?
ex.a: Tour agents and service requests live in your property management system, which is not connected to this app. Tours you log in Tour mode are on your desk list.

We cannot see each person’s reason, but here is what they see when they compare you:
  • The Flats At SanTan next door waives app and admin fees on a same day lease.
  • Move in cost is $285 against a $189 rival average.
  • Size adjusted, the fastest rivals ask less per square foot.
What wins them back: up to 10 weeks free, the sky lounge, gated access and garages on select homes.

The Flats At SanTan: up to 8 weeks free, fees waived on a same day lease. SanTan by Baron: 8 weeks free plus 6 months free garage. Redstone: up to 8 weeks free on 14 to 18 month leases. Town Commons: up to 10 weeks free. Luma Rise: up to 10 weeks free plus a $1,000 gift card. Ours: up to 10 weeks free on select homes.

The rivals leasing fastest: Town Commons and Zaterra (5.6 a week each), Redstone at SanTan Village (4.0), SanTan by Baron (3.8) and The Flats At SanTan (3.6). Elevation SanTan signs 1.4 a week at 96.6% leased.
Our 1 bedroom average asking rent is $1,680 and 2 bedroom $2,205. B4 reads about 19% above market for its size and B3 about 5%. S2 and S1 are listed longest, so feature them first.
4.4 stars from 120 Google reviews. The six newest all have replies.

ex.q: Is AI sending renters our way?
ex.a: AI answer tracking for Elevation SanTan is not in the app yet. It arrives with the Weekly Pulse.
